links.outcome: Model AUC by gender and racial subgroups for dental service use prediction
links.effect: Consistent performance across gender; disparities across racial groups, with AUC = 0.57 for self-reported mixed (pardos) skin color versus overall AUC 0.77.
links.quote: Fairness estimations for the best model indicated consistent performance across gender categories. However, disparities were observed among racial groups, AUC = 0.57 for individuals who self-reported mixed ("pardos") skin color.

unlisted_practices: Explainability analysis (feature importance) of a predictive model for dental service use

screen.reason: Evaluates predictive ML models for dental service use with a specific focus on algorithmic fairness across gender and racial subgroups, but does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
